primary_quantity: Phi_M(A,B;S)=-sum_{J in J_S(B)\J_S(A)} 1[|J|=2^h-1 for some h>=2]

A_rotation_bound.domain: Any complete same-key BST pair and fixed S, with original SET duplicate suppression. All orientations and private nodes included.

H3q_first_maximum_obstruction.conclusion: No finite absolute beta,gamma can bound u+Delta_B Phi_M by beta*d+gamma*k on all original B phases.

positive_demand_restoration_obstruction.conclusion: Positive-demand phases alone also violate every such fixed-coefficient law, even with an additional fixed multiple of the incoming A KEEP-gap cost.

post_derivation_scope_extension.weights: Arbitrary fixed signed finite real values w_h, independent of source/support/ambient size. Only finitely many occur in each finite state.
post_derivation_scope_extension.critical_necessity: For each p>=3, the last critical H_(p,q) phase has u=q, d=2,k=1,Delta=-q*w_(p+1). Letting q grow forces w_h>=1 for all h>=4.
post_derivation_scope_extension.restoration_contradiction: The first forward KEEP3 in H_(p,5) has Delta=sum_(h=2)^(p+1) w_h. Then u+Delta >=ceil(p/2)+(p-2)+w2+w3 -> infinity, while d<=3,k=1 and incoming A gap=1.
post_derivation_scope_extension.claim: The complete B-phase certificate is impossible throughout this entire reweighted layer family. This is a corollary of the same exact source transitions, not a changed success criterion.

strictly_larger_obstruction_class.coefficients: All fixed signed finite real lambda_i and fixed signed finite real scale weights w_h, independent of source and ambient population.
strictly_larger_obstruction_class.critical_old_feature_delta: (0,0,0,-2) for all p>=3 at the last critical H_(p,q) phase
strictly_larger_obstruction_class.restoration_old_feature_delta: (0,-1,-1,-d), d=2+1[p even], at first forward KEEP3 of H_(p,5), p>=3
strictly_larger_obstruction_class.proof: Critical q variation still forces w_h>=1 for h>=4. Restoration contributes sum(w_h)-lambda_P-lambda_F-d*lambda_S, whose unbounded growth cannot be canceled by fixed old coefficients. Even a fixed multiple of incoming KEEP-gap A work is1 at that restoration access.
strictly_larger_obstruction_class.scope_limit: Does not exclude arbitrary cardinality weights outside the Mersenne support, source-dependent weight assignments, other A/B geometry, or globally overlapping-window laws with a separately proved budget.

fixed_layer_positive_theorem.quantity: B_r(W) = all actual B SET births with proper nonempty S-label cardinality exactly r
fixed_layer_positive_theorem.bound: B_r<=K_B<=A, for every r>=1, uniformly in r and source
fixed_layer_positive_theorem.reason: Every B SET death contains the accessed key, so at most one distinct size-r label dies per B access; new labels exclude that key and cannot die in that access. Cyclic birth/death totals agree.
fixed_layer_positive_theorem.scoped_demand_class: Original U_int doubles whose own two bits include an actual size-r SET birth; choose the earliest such bit. The class has size<=A.
fixed_layer_positive_theorem.literal_complement: Original U_int demands with no such own-double size-r birth.
fixed_layer_positive_theorem.novelty_limit: An exact-layer potential realization/sharpening of the prior bounded-cardinality birth mechanism. No strict enlargement of the frozen UF paid class has been established.

status: Required A-locality and linear H3q burst response proved symbolically; the selected global B law has new exact parametric source obstructions. Universal CD and Dynamic Optimality remain open.
